response.sql: WITH type_averages AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) as type_avg_price FROM Products WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL GROUP BY production_type_code), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(unit_price) as overall_avg_price FROM Products WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL), above_overall AS (SELECT ta.production_type_code, ta.type_avg_price FROM type_averages ta CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE oa.overall_avg_price IS NOT NULL AND ta.type_avg_price > oa.overall_avg_price), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(type_avg_price) as mean_of_kept FROM above_overall), final_types AS (SELECT ao.type_avg_price FROM above_overall ao CROSS JOIN kept_mean km WHERE km.mean_of_kept IS NOT NULL AND ao.type_avg_price > km.mean_of_kept) SELECT AVG(ft.type_avg_price) as avg_type_price, AVG(ft.type_avg_price - oa.overall_avg_price) as avg_above_overall, AVG(ft.type_avg_price - km.mean_of_kept) as avg_above_kept_mean FROM final_types ft CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa CROSS JOIN kept_mean km
